title: Derived internal Hom dualizes the free local coefficient telescope
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small category with Grothendieck topology $J$, let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings, and let $U\in\mathcal C$. Write $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(R|_U)$ for module sheaves on the slice ringed site [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-local-coefficient-localization]. For $f\in R(U)$ put $P=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}R|_U$ with inclusions $\iota_n$, and define $d:P\to P$ by $\iota_n d=\iota_n-f\iota_{n+1}$, where $f$ acts by local section multiplication. Assume the global and slice derived categories exist [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For $K\in D(R)$ let $L=K|_U$. If $\prod_{n\ge0}L$ exists, there is an isomorphism $e:R\mathcal Hom(P[0],L)\xrightarrow\sim\prod_{n\ge0}L$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] such that $e\circ R\mathcal Hom(d,L)=(1-s_f)\circ e$, where $s_f$ has coordinate maps $\pi_{n+1}$ followed by the specified local section derived multiplication on $L$ [def-weil-tower-transition-endomorphism, def-weil-pbc-local-coefficient-localization].

proof.text: Choose a complex M representing the restricted target L and the functorial K-injective replacement I of M. The natural comparison for derived internal Hom identifies RHom(P[0],L) with Q(Hom-complex(P[0],I)), naturally in P. Use the actual projection specification of the chosen Hom complex, not an arbitrary objectwise isomorphism.

proof.text: For a source in degree zero all factors of the degree-n Hom product except source degree zero vanish. The surviving projection is invertible. Evaluation at one identifies Hom from the coefficient unit with the target, and its compatibility with the differential supplies a chain isomorphism. Internal Hom takes the countable coproduct of units to the product fan, with legs given by precomposition with the summand inclusions followed by evaluation. The projection-map identity proves the precise coordinate formula.

source.place: Tag 0997, lemma-hom-from-Af, proof of the equivalence of (1) and (3).

proof.text: Apply the termwise product theorem to the constant family of K-injectives I. It proves that Q sends the product fan of complexes, with its actual projections, to a product fan in the derived category. Transport the factors through Q(I) isomorphic to L and the point through the natural derived-Hom comparison. The uniqueness of product cones gives the required product isomorphism.

proof.text: Precomposition on the unit by multiplication by f becomes multiplication on I under evaluation: a local linear map phi satisfies phi(f times 1)=f times phi(1). The section multiplication commutes with every chain map, hence with the resolution map M to I. The formula for the localized natural transformation and its naturality along the chosen representative isomorphism identify Q of the chain scalar on I with the specified derived multiplication on the restricted K.

proof.text: The telescope satisfies inclusion_n followed by d = inclusion_n minus f followed by inclusion_(n+1). Additivity and contravariant functoriality of derived internal Hom convert this to projection_n minus projection_(n+1) followed by the derived scalar. Product extensionality identifies the conjugated map with the tower transition endomorphism 1 minus the shift.

theorem localCoefficientTelescope_rhom_product
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (U : C) (f : R.obj.obj (op U))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ringedSiteModules.{u} (localCoefficientRings R))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wSlice} (ringedSiteModules.{u} ((localCoefficientRings R).over U))]
    (K : DerivedCategory (ringedSiteModules.{u} (localCoefficientRings R)))
    [HasProduct (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (localCoefficientDerivedRestriction R U).obj K)] :
    let L := (localCoefficientDerivedRestriction R U).obj K
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (ringedSiteModules.{u} ((localCoefficientRings R).over U)) 0
    let H : (DerivedCategory
        (ringedSiteModules.{u} ((localCoefficientRings R).over U)))ᵒᵖ ⥤
        DerivedCategory (ringedSiteModules.{u} ((localCoefficientRings R).over U)) :=
      (Functor.curry.obj (derivedInternalHom (J.over U) (R.over U))).flip.obj L
    ∃ e : H.obj (op (S.obj (localCoefficientFree R U))) ≅ ∏ᶜ (fun _ : ℕ ↦ L),
      H.map (S.map (localCoefficientTelescopeMap R U f)).op ≫ e.hom =
        e.hom ≫ towerTransitionEndomorphism
          (K := fun _ : ℕ ↦ L) (fun _ ↦ (localSectionDerivedMultiplication R U f).app K)
